pairs: Our God is our refuge and strength,
adjutor in tribulationibus quæ invenerunt nos nimis.
a helper in the tribulations that have greatly overwhelmed us.
Propterea non timebimus dum turbabitur terra,
et transferentur montes in cor maris.
we will not be afraid when the earth will be turbulent and the mountains will be transferred into the heart of the sea.
and the waters were stirred up among them;
conturbati sunt montes in fortitudine ejus.
the mountains have been disturbed by his strength.
The frenzy of the river rejoices the city of God.
The Most High has sanctified his tabernacle.
God will assist it in the early morning.
and the kingdoms have been bowed down.
The Lord of hosts is with us.
The God of Jacob is our supporter.
and behold the works of the Lord:
what portents he has set upon the earth,
auferens bella usque ad finem terræ.
carrying away wars even to the end of the earth.
and he will burn the shield with fire.
et videte quoniam ego sum Deus;
and see that I am God.
I will be exalted among the peoples,
and I will be exalted upon the earth.
The Lord of hosts is with us.
The God of Jacob is our supporter.
